description: A Drupal module form class for merging contents of one workspace into another, including form building, user prompts, and merge execution.

classes.name: WorkspaceMergeForm
classes.description: A form class for merging one workspace into another within Drupal, handling form display, user confirmation, and merge logic.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an instance of the form class, injecting necessary services from the container.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the form.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form, including listing mergeable changes and handling no-change scenarios.

methods.name: getQuestion
methods.description: Returns the confirmation question for merging workspaces.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Provides a description of the form purpose.

methods.name: getCancelUrl
methods.description: Returns URL to cancel the form and go back to workspace collection.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Executes the merge operation and displays a success message.
